analysis_summary.reason: The patch is a memory leak fix (ITS#10543) in tests/progs/slapd-read.c, a test-only program. It replaces free(values) with ldap_charray_free(values) to properly free LDAP-allocated DN strings stored in the values array. This change has zero impact on any public API, ABI, CLI behavior, configuration, or protocol. The file is under tests/ and is not shipped as part of any library or production binary.
analysis_summary.notes: This is a low-risk internal bugfix with no external observable compatibility impact.
